pages.note: The upper two thirds of the page, under its own printed title อุททิสสะนาธิฏฐานะคาถา, which carries no chant number. SET IN TWO COLUMNS: one printed line runs across both, the left column holding the first pāda and the right the second, and it is read across the row. The verses fall in two printed stanza groups, seven lines then nine, with a blank line between them and the second group indented at its first line. It ends with a centred colophon.

The lower third of the page, below the colophon: an instruction paragraph closing the evening service, then a centred heading opening the explanatory notes to it, then the first numbered note. The note is CUT BY THE PAGE — its sentence stops at ทาสี and runs on to page 63. No footnote rule and no footnote on this page.

blocks.thai: เมื่อสวด อุททิสสะนาธิฏฐานะคาถา จบแล้ว พึงนั่งสงบแผ่ส่วนบุญกุศลแด่ท่านบรรพบุรุษบุรพาจารย์ และท่านผู้มีพระคุณอื่น ๆ ตลอดถึงสรรพสัตว์ทุกชั้นชาติสักครู่หนึ่ง แล้วนั่งคุกเข่ากราบด้วยเบญจางคประดิษฐ์ 3 หน พร้อมๆ กัน ประธานสั่งเลิกประชุม เป็นอันเสร็จพิธีทำวัตรสวดมนต์ภาคเย็นเท่านี้.
blocks.english: When the Uddissanādhiṭṭhānagāthā has been chanted to its end, one should sit quietly and share the merit with forebears and former teachers, and with all others to whom gratitude is owed, and on to all beings of every station, for a short while. Then kneel and bow with the fivefold prostration three times, all together. The presiding monk dismisses the assembly, and with this the evening service of devotions and chanting is complete.

chants.title_thai: อุททิสสะนาธิฏฐานะคาถา
chants.title_english: The Verses of Dedication and Resolve

closing.pali: อุททิสสะนาธิฏฐานะคาถา นิฏฐิตา
closing.english: Here end the Verses of Dedication and Resolve.

verses.pali: อิมินา ปุญญะกัมเมนะ อุปัชฌายา คุณุตตะรา
verses.english: By this meritorious deed — may my preceptors, of the highest virtue,

verses.pali: อาจะริยูปะการา จะ มาตาปิตา จะ ญาตะกา.
verses.english: the teachers who have helped me, my mother and father and kinsfolk,

verses.pali: สุริโย จันทิมา ราชา คุณะวันตา นะราปิ จะ
verses.pali_roman: Suriyo candimā rājā guṇavantā narāpi ca
verses.english: the sun, the moon, the king, and people of virtue too,

verses.pali: พ๎รัห๎มะมารา จะ อินทา จะ โลกะปาลา จะ เทวะตา.
verses.pali_roman: Brahmamārā ca indā ca lokapālā ca devatā.
verses.english: brahmās and māras and indras, the guardians of the world and the devas,

verses.pali: ยะโม มิตตา มะนุสสา จะ มัชฌัตตา เวริกาปิ จะ
verses.pali_roman: Yamo mittā manussā ca majjhattā verikāpi ca
verses.english: Yama, friends and human beings, the indifferent and the hostile alike —

verses.pali: สัพเพ สัตตา สุขี โหนตุ ปุญญานิ ปะกะตานิ เม.
verses.pali_roman: Sabbe sattā sukhī hontu puññāni pakatāni me.
verses.english: may all beings be happy. May the merits I have made

verses.pali: สุขัง จะ ติวิธัง เทนตุ ขิปปัง ปาเปถะ โว มะตัง.
verses.pali_roman: Sukhaṃ ca tividhaṃ dentu khippaṃ pāpetha vo mataṃ.
verses.english: give happiness of the three kinds, and swiftly bring you to what you intend.

verses.pali: อิมินา ปุญญะกัมเมนะ อิมินา อุททิเสนะ จะ
verses.english: By this meritorious deed and by this dedication,

verses.pali: ขิปปาหัง สุละเภ เจวะ ตัณหุปาทานะเฉทะนัง.
verses.english: may I swiftly come to the cutting off of craving and clinging.

verses.pali: เย สันตาเน หินา ธัมมา ยาวะ นิพพานะโต มะมัง
verses.pali_roman: Ye santāne hinā dhammā yāva nibbānato mamaṃ
verses.english: Whatever base states are in my mind-stream, until I reach nibbāna,

verses.pali: นัสสันตุ สัพพะทา เยวะ ยัตถะ ชาโต ภะเว ภะเว.
verses.pali_roman: Nassantu sabbadā yeva yattha jāto bhave bhave.
verses.english: may they perish always, wherever I am born, in birth after birth.

verses.pali: อุชุจิตตัง สะติปัญญา สัลเลโข วิริยัมหินา
verses.english: May uprightness of mind, mindfulness and wisdom, austerity and energy be mine;

verses.pali: มารา ละภันตุ โนกาสัง กาตุญจะ วิริเยสุ เม.
verses.pali_roman: Mārā labhantu nokāsaṃ kātuñca viriyesu me.
verses.english: and may the māras find no opening to act against my efforts.

verses.pali: พุทธาธิปะวะโร นาโถ ธัมโม นาโถ วะรุตตะโม
verses.english: The Buddha, the foremost refuge; the Dhamma, the most excellent refuge;

verses.pali: นาโถ ปัจเจกะพุทโธ จะ สังโฆ นาโถตตะโร มะมัง.
verses.pali_roman: Nātho paccekabuddho ca saṅgho nāthottaro mamaṃ.
verses.english: the Paccekabuddha, a refuge; and the Sangha, my highest refuge.

verses.pali: เตโสตตะมานุภาเวนะ มาโรกาสัง ละภันตุ มา.
verses.english: By the power of these supreme ones, may the māras find no opening at all.

vocabulary.pali: ปุญญะกัมเมนะ
vocabulary.meaning: by the meritorious deed just done; the chant hands on the good of the act it follows rather than keeping it
preceptors — the monk who ordains and takes responsibility for a pupil, named first among those the merit goes to
by the dedication; the act of naming who the merit is for, which is what gives this chant its title

vocabulary.pali: ตัณหุปาทานะ
vocabulary.meaning: craving and clinging — the two links the chant asks to have cut, taken together as one knot
effacement; the wearing away of what is coarse in oneself, a training word rather than an austerity for its own sake
a refuge, a protector; the word repeated through the last three lines as the Three Jewels are named
an opening for Māra; the gap through which distraction and unskilful states get in, which the chant asks to be closed

checks.issue: TWO COLUMNS, AND THIS IS THE READING THAT MOST NEEDS CONFIRMING. Every line of this chant runs ACROSS both columns: the left holds the first pāda, the right the second. The first pairing made is left `อิมินา ปุญญะกัมเมนะ` with right `อุปัชฌายา คุณุตตะรา`, joined by a single space as verse 1. The halves were paired by row position, checked two ways: the full stops fall only at the ends of right-hand halves, in the alternating pattern a couplet gives, and reading the left column straight down produces a run of unfinished half-lines rather than continuous sense. Reading down the columns instead of across would produce fluent and completely wrong Pali, so this is worth one look at the book.

THE TITLE IS SPELT TWO WAYS IN THIS BOOK. Page 62 prints อุททิสสะนาธิฏฐานะคาถา with a doubled ท in both the title and the colophon, and page 61's rubric spells it the same way in both places it names it — all four read at 5x or better. But CONTENTS, transcribed from the book's own สารบัญ, has อุทิสสะนาธิฏฐานะคาถา with a single ท, at both its page-62 and page-239 listings. Nothing has been changed on either side. The page and the contents page disagree, or one of the two readings is wrong, and only the book settles which.

The book prints หินา with a SHORT ิ, giving hinā, where standard editions have hīnā with a long ī. Read at 7x against the ั of สันตาเน on the same line, which is plainly a different mark. Kept as printed.

The book prints วิริยัมหินา with short ิ in both syllables, giving viriyamhinā, where standard editions have vīriyamhinā with a long ī. Read at 7x. Kept as printed, and consistent with the same short vowel at verse 13's วิริเยสุ.

พ์รัห์มะมารา carries the small mark twice, over the พ and over the ห, and at 7x both are the ε-shaped curl with a tail — the same shape page 60 showed isolated on ท์วายะ. Written with U+0E4C, consistent with pages 51-61. This is the sixth page agreeing about the mark this printer cuts.

The colophon อุททิสสะนาธิฏฐานะคาถา นิฏฐิตา is printed centred and bold under the chant, with NO full stop, as on pages 60 and 61. Recorded in the closing field so the app sets it as a colophon rather than numbering it as a chanted line. It is นิฏฐิตา here, feminine to agree with คาถา, where the two pages before have นิฏฐิโต with ปาโฐ.

THE PAGE'S LAST BLOCK IS CUT BY THE PAGE TURN. Numbered note 1 stops mid-sentence at สังฆัสสาหัส์มิ ทาสี and continues on page 63. Reproduced exactly as far as the page carries it, with no attempt to finish the sentence. The line sits close to the foot of the sheet and a thumb is in the frame at the lower left, over the margin only — there is clear white paper between the last line and the thumb, so nothing is hidden. Page 63 completes it.

พุทธัสสาหัส์มิ is broken across a line end inside numbered note 1, WITH a hyphen — the line ends พุทธัสสา- and the next begins หัส์มิ. Rejoined and the hyphen dropped, the same rule the run-on passages follow. The word is printed unbroken five more times in the same note, which confirms the join.

The instruction paragraph spaces its two mai yamok differently: อื่น ๆ has a space before the ๆ and พร้อมๆ has none, four lines apart in the same paragraph. Both reproduced exactly as printed rather than made consistent.

The book sets this chant as TWO stanza groups, seven lines then nine, separated by a blank line, with the second group's first line indented like the first group's. The app has no field for a blank line inside a verse-set chant — `para_start` splits a prose chant only — so the break is recorded here and in the working notes rather than written. Worth knowing before the next two-stanza page arrives.

The right half of the last line, มาโรกาสัง ละภันตุ มา., sits a little lower on the page than its left half เตโสตตะมานุภาเวนะ, where every other row is level. Read as one line anyway: it is the only unpaired half left on either side, and the sentence it completes needs it. Noted because a drifting baseline is what would make a mispairing look reasonable.

batch_status.notes: THE ONE THING TO CHECK FIRST IS THE COLUMN READING. This is the first two-column page in this run — pages 51 to 61 were all single column — and reading down a column instead of across a row is the failure this book makes easiest and hides best. The pairing is set out in the first check with the evidence for it. Second: the page and the book's own contents page spell the chant's title differently, อุททิสสะ against อุทิสสะ, and nothing has been changed on either side. Third: numbered note 1 is deliberately incomplete — the page cuts it mid-sentence and page 63 finishes it, so the block is a half sentence on purpose. Nothing on this page needs re-photographing.
